events.what: Pan proves the two-dimensional regular Fontaine-Mazur conjecture over Q in the residually reducible case for p>=5
Zhang claims to remove the p=3 exceptional case of the two-dimensional regular Fontaine-Mazur conjecture over Q, completing Pan's result for all odd primes
events.credibility_reason: No expert uptake found in nearly two years; the only assessment (Pith, automated, not a knock-down per F11) flags a possibly sketchy local epsilon=+-1 case. The arXiv text-overlap note is explained by the record as a sequel relationship, so it is not itself a strong signal.

events.what: Thorne proves further cases of the Fontaine-Mazur conjecture for GL(2) (potentially crystalline ordinary, Hodge-Tate weights {0,1}, totally odd determinant), including some previously-open reducible-residual cases at p=2

judgement.doubts: The bullet covers 'numerous conjectures'; both post-snapshot events are cases of the GL(2)/two-dimensional part, so partial is the ceiling (F2). Zhang and Thorne share the partial tier; neither uses AI, so the choice of resting event does not affect ai_role or direction. The 2026-09-24 hand corrections are endorsed, though I would weigh the text-overlap note less than they did.
